equations.quote: The factor 0.8 considers the fact that the tube centers are located on a circle
equations.description: Tube count around the throat for tube internal diameter d and wall thickness 0.020 in (d + 0.04 = outer diameter); 0.8 accounts for tube centres lying on a circle. The printed expanded form (0.8d + 24.93)/(d + 0.04) omits the factor pi; SP-125 itself substitutes pi(0.8d + 24.93)/(d + 0.04) on the next page.
